data.name: HelpIntroduction
data.value:
Worms Map Editor Usage: WormsLandEditor.exe [command] No arguments: open the graphical editor. --help: print this help. Command names are case-sensitive; quote paths that contain spaces. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 execution failure, 2 invalid arguments.
Commands:

data.name: HelpFooter
data.value: All write/export commands may overwrite files without confirmation or backups. DAT saves may quantize colors. Resource writes always produce Level.Dir in the indicated directory and normalize SPR data. Multiple-file writes are not transactional. Diagnostics are advanced tools, not compatibility guarantees. See docs/cli.md.

data.value: --normalize-level-dir <Level.Dir> Rewrite Level.Dir in its directory; normalize SPR resources.
